LankaLaw consolidated edition to Act No. 43 of 2024 (text layer, publisher not printed). Settled the true HTML cutoff (4 of 2005) and supplied the wording of every post-2005 change applied to the tree (sections 5, 9, 18, 22, 27, 29, 55, 59-61, 66, 68, 70, 71A, 79A-79C, 80, 80A, 86, 88, 93, 94, 101-104, 104A, 109, 117, 121, 142A-142H, 146-148, 149A, 151A, 154A, 175, 205, 338, 393-398B, 405, 440B, 440C, 524, 525, 527-530, 541, 544, 545, 554, 653, 774, 801-833R); compared section by section against the tree with a word-level diff of all 775 shared sections

statute_note: Principal source: the accepted tree parsed from LankaLaw's consolidated HTML (2-1889-civil-procedure-code-consolidated.html), whose header chain ends at Act No. 4 of 2005; the earlier package note calling it 'through Act No. 43 of 2024' described the PDF, not the HTML. Other sources inspected: the LankaLaw consolidated PDF (233 pp, text layer, chain to 43 of 2024), the 38 held amending-Act PDFs (title pages opened; 21 of the pre-2005 files and 3 others are scans without a text layer), the LankaLaw HTML copies of amending Acts named in the RUBRIK, and the registry row (PDF sha256 matches). The registry's local_markdown_path does not exist on disk and was not used. An untracked data/processed/canonical-statutes/SRC030-2-1889-consolidated-2024.json written at 01:12 on 2026-09-05 by another agent was not used. Consolidation cutoff: baseline 4 of 2005; extended to 43 of 2024 by applying, from the PDF wording and cross-checked against each held Act, every change attributable to 11 of 2010, 8 of 2017, 5 of 2022, 17 of 2022, 36 of 2022, 20 of 2023, 29 of 2023 and 43 of 2024 (the tree's provenance.what_changed lists all 143 edits). Not applied: 7 of 2023 (not held; the PDF's new section 431A is therefore absent and recorded in omitted_provisions). Review performed: (1) a programmatic word-level diff of all 775 sections shared by the tree and the PDF (PDF text extracted with poppler pdftotext -tsv, marginal column excluded), which located every post-2005 change and the HTML-only defects; (2) six read-only reviewers, one per range (1-150, 151-300, 301-450, 451-600, 601-750, 751-840), each of which compared the full text of every section in its range against the HTML by word-level diff and read the last provision of every section, using the PDF for section presence and marker years; every finding acted on was verified against the HTML or PDF first. Findings acted on: 22 Illustration/Explanation blocks the parser had dropped were restored from the HTML (sections 7, 34, 42, 150, 151, 153, 154, 155, 196, 207, 218, 232, 345, 413, 503, 582, 632, 653); the 218 proviso moved to its printed position; marginal notes absorbed into body text removed from 9, 25, 218, 255, 704, 776(1); 756(2)(a) split out; 757(5) marker node removed; 807 provisos reordered; Part X added; 544(1) nominee clause restored from the PDF. Findings left as printed (source defects shared by HTML and PDF, or parser habits outside this pass): 8, 19, 20, 33, 34(1), 46(2), 50, 63, 67, 90, 113(1), 116(1), 122, 227, 259(2), 663, 745(a), 758(1)(e), 766, 822, 832(2), 837(1); subsection-level marginal notes are not carried anywhere in the tree. Structure, cross-references and metadata lenses were not re-run in this pass beyond the changed nodes. Amendment coverage: 59 instruments reconciled below: 46 already in the baseline chain, 8 applied from held sources, 1 known but not held (7 of 2023), 4 ambiguous (27 of 2023 Fisheries, 36 of 1981, 39 of 1988, 79 of 1980). Repealed provisions keep their 2005 text in text_before_amendment with repealed=true (146-148, 405, 121(2), 80A stub, Part IXA 801-833R including both nodes numbered 808). Structural weaknesses: section 808 is printed twice in the HTML with no 806 (order 804, 805, 808, 807, 808, 809; the PDF omits the whole Part, so cannot settle it); the PDF numbers section 105 as 105A; section 544(1) rests on the PDF alone (Act 20 of 2002 is a scan); the marker '[7, 27 of 2023]' on section 5 is unexplained; the First Schedule forms are not carried by either source; section 227's duplicated proviso is a source defect. Missing sources: Act No. 7 of 2023; text-layer copies of the 24 scanned amending Acts; the 16 pre-1949 Ordinances and 11 of 1995. Unresolved: the 105/105A numbering; whether 27 of 2023 or 7 of 2023 touches section 5; 806/808. Status: needs_structural_review. Lawyer verification: unverified.
